item.title: Rep. Thomas Massie moves to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the Iran war
item.description: Rep. Thomas Massie has moved to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. The Kentucky Republican alleges that Hegseth has waged the Iran war illegally, among other "high crimes and misdemeanors."

item.title: As campaign season gears up, AI-generated ads are everywhere
item.description: Data suggests many candidates are embracing AI this year to boost their image and portray their opponents unfavorably. But whether it will turn out voters remains unclear.

item.title: Judge blocks DHS from acting against a man over a harsh email to an ICE official
item.description: ICE agents turned up at David Streever's home over a harsh email he sent to an ICE official. Now a court order prevents the federal government from making additional threats against him.
